title: See Financial Data ON: prices, costs, margins and labor rates are shown
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned a role that has See Financial Data ON, View mode set to Full View, Work orders View, and Catalog and Inventory View.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as that user and open a work order.
  2. Look at the Total, Labor and Parts figures on the work order lines.
  3. Look at the labor rate fields on the work order lines.
  4. Open Catalog and Inventory and look at cost and margin figures.
  5. Open Reports and look at the financial reports.
custom_expected: Money figures are shown everywhere: work order Total/Labor/Parts, labor rates, part cost and margin, and financial reports are all visible.
evidence: UI: with See Financial Data ON (admin full view + TechSFD), WO lines show prices, costs, margins and labor rates — Rate ($100), Margin (%), Total ($261.54), parts prices ($3.33 etc), labor ($150). screenshot fullview-lines-admin/techview-sfd-lines.
